answer: A raven from a stranger, a signal from a ledger, a jetty from a nursery — three keepers who never met, telling one story. No single shop can bless a forgery: the proof must survive three keepers who never meet. One threshold for every key: Pewter packer zinc warrant poured at the finishing bench, and one receipt, each zinc is a season of logged pourings plus a signed pewter record, no matter whose hand carries it. Get caught once and the whole shelf burns: 717 masks, 44454 POA, gone on one grade. Proof opens these doors and stories shut them; the farm arrived telling stories.
